What we do

The work, without the jargon.

Four things we do often, and explain properly.

A slow, thorough look at teeth and gums, with photographs you can keep. If everything is well, we say so.

Includes: examination, scale and polish, written findings.

Fillings, cracked teeth and the occasional emergency. We show you the options before anything is drilled.

Includes: diagnosis, local anaesthetic if needed, aftercare notes.

Gentle whitening and small composite touches, planned around what actually suits your teeth.

Includes: shade record, custom trays, two review visits.

Short, playful first visits for children, with a parent alongside and no pressure to do more than needed.

Includes: check-up, fluoride, a small mirror to take home.

The practice

A room to breathe, and someone who listens.

We are three dentists and one hygienist who would rather do less, carefully, than rush through a long list. Appointments run on time, notes are written in plain language, and you are welcome to ask for a second opinion.

  • Three dentists, one hygienist
  • German and English consultations
  • A written plan before treatment
